description: Graph Insights — embedded knowledge graph panels within the Reflection Dashboard showing cross-run patterns, rule influence, pipeline events, step provenance, and workflow version lineage. Also includes a compact patterns widget on the Active Dashboard and pattern indicators in run history.

groups.name: Graph Insights Section in Reflection Dashboard
groups.description: The Reflection Dashboard includes a 'Graph Insights' section that embeds CrossRunPatternsPanel, RuleInfluencePanel, PipelineEventsTimeline, StepProvenanceTimeline, and WorkflowVersionLineage as sub-panels within the existing reflection view.

assertions.description: Users can identify the Graph Insights section within the Reflection Dashboard, understanding it as a collection of knowledge graph analysis panels
The Graph Insights section includes the CrossRunPatternsPanel, showing recurring findings and fix oscillations detected across multiple workflow runs
The Graph Insights section includes the RuleInfluencePanel, showing generation rule effectiveness within the reflection context

groups.name: Active Dashboard Top Patterns Widget
groups.description: The Active Dashboard shows a compact TopPatternsWidget that summarizes active cross-run patterns (recurring findings and fix oscillations), auto-hiding when no patterns exist.

assertions.description: Users can see a Cross-Run Patterns heading on the Active Dashboard, providing a compact summary of detected patterns without navigating to the full Graph Insights view
The widget displays the count of recurring findings detected across runs, helping users quickly assess whether systemic issues exist
The widget displays the count of fix oscillations (fixes that are applied and reverted repeatedly), flagging unstable self-healing behavior

groups.name: Run History Pattern Indicator
groups.description: Run history rows show a small orange badge with the count of active cross-run patterns for each workflow, helping users spot problematic workflows at a glance.

assertions.description: Run history rows display a numeric badge with a tooltip showing the count of active cross-run patterns, enabling users to identify which workflows have the most recurring issues

target.label: Numeric pattern count badge with tooltip

groups.name: Graph Data Flow Architecture
groups.description: All graph panels consume data from the /graph/* MCP endpoints via React Query hooks (useGraphAnalytics.ts) with 30-second stale time and 60-second polling interval. Event-driven refresh (useGraphDataRefresh.ts) invalidates queries when tasks or reflections complete.

assertions.description: Graph panels automatically refresh their data when tasks or reflections complete, ensuring users always see up-to-date analytics without manual refresh

target.label: Data refreshes after task completion (architecture validation)

groups.name: Graph Insights Navigation
groups.description: Graph insight panels are accessible through multiple navigation paths: embedded in the Reflection Dashboard tab, as standalone tabs (element-reliability, pipeline-events, rule-influence, unified-search, workflow-versions), and via the global Cmd+K palette.

assertions.description: The Graph Insights section is visible within the Reflection Dashboard when a workflow is selected
Each graph panel is registered as a standalone tab (element-reliability, pipeline-events, rule-influence, unified-search, workflow-versions) in the TabContent router

groups.name: Data Refresh Behavior
groups.description: Graph data refreshes on two cadences: React Query polling (30s stale, 60s interval) and event-driven invalidation via useGraphDataRefresh when tasks or reflections complete. The TopPatternsWidget auto-hides when no active patterns exist.

assertions.description: The TopPatternsWidget returns null (not rendered) when there are no active cross-run patterns, keeping the Active Dashboard clean
The PatternIndicator badge returns null when active pattern count is 0, keeping run history rows clean for healthy workflows
assertions.precondition: The workflow has no active patterns

assertions.description: When a task run or reflection completes, all graph data queries are invalidated and refetched automatically via the useGraphDataRefresh hook (500ms debounce)
assertions.precondition: GraphQL subscriptions are active and a task run or reflection just completed

groups.name: Cross-Panel State Consistency
groups.description: The pattern count shown in TopPatternsWidget (Active Dashboard) must match the data shown in CrossRunPatternsPanel (Reflection Dashboard) since both consume the same useCrossRunPatterns hook. Similarly, PatternIndicator badges in run history must reflect the same pattern counts.

assertions.description: The recurring finding and fix oscillation counts in TopPatternsWidget are consistent with the detailed patterns shown in CrossRunPatternsPanel, as both use the same API endpoint and React Query cache
assertions.precondition: Both TopPatternsWidget and CrossRunPatternsPanel are visible (active patterns exist)

metadata.author: Joshua Spinak
preconditions: Reflection Dashboard Graph Insights section requires a workflow to be selected in the reflection dropdown
TopPatternsWidget auto-hides when no active cross-run patterns exist — invisible on healthy/fresh systems
PatternIndicator auto-hides when a workflow has no active patterns
Cross-run patterns require minimum 3 occurrences of the same finding signature across different runs
backendDependencies: GET /graph/cross-run-patterns?workflow_name=<optional> — consumed by TopPatternsWidget, CrossRunPatternsPanel, PatternIndicator
